On June 21, Apple Watch users will be able to earn a special badge and animated iMessage stickers by completing Apple’s International Day of Yoga Challenge. Here’s how to get them.

International Day of Yoga Challenge set for June 21

Apple regularly offers limited-time Activity Challenges tied to holidays and special events. This Sunday, Apple Watch users will be able to earn a new award in celebration of International Day of Yoga.

Here’s what users need to do to earn the awards, according to Apple:

Apple’s International Day of Yoga Challenge has varied over the years. In some years, users had to record a 20-minute yoga workout, while this year’s challenge requires only 10 minutes.

It’s worth mentioning that Apple Fitness+ offers guided yoga sessions, so if you’re a subscriber and have never given yoga a try, this could be a nice opportunity to take that first lesson.

Users who have never subscribed to Apple Fitness+ can also try it for free for a month, then pay $9.99 per month or $79.99 annually.
